question: Which powers are invoked to dwell on the forehead and on the head?
premises: Maṇḍalā is asked to dwell on the forehead.
Virajā is asked to dwell on the head.
inference: Maṇḍalā is invoked on the forehead and Virajā on the head.
plain_english: May Maṇḍalā dwell on the forehead; may Virajā dwell on the head.
